_comment: Service catalogue order — source of truth. deploy.sh:apply_services rewrites the svcMeta array in site/index.html + site/GeorgeAI.dc.html and the cats/items blocks of site/services-data.js from this file on every deploy, so a re-export cannot silently revert the positioning. The homepage groups services by category (cats order) and numbers them by array order, so BOTH follow the five commercial priorities: 1 vibe code Python/Django/PostgreSQL, 2 n8n automation, 3 CRM/ERP, 4 SEO/GEO/AIO, 5 AI consultant. `order` lists every card by its export name (prose is moved by name, never by position); `new` holds cards the export does not ship, with full prose in all five languages. Mirror any change into seo/noscript.html and georgeai_services.json (the /services/ hub).

en.tagline: Know what to automate before you spend a euro.
en.intro: A hands-on AI consultant for owner-run businesses: I audit your processes, pick the two or three places where AI and automation pay back fastest, and give you a roadmap your team can actually execute.
includes: Process and tooling audit (half a day on site or remote)
Prioritised AI roadmap with costs, risks and quick wins
Vendor-neutral model and tool selection (Claude, OpenAI, open source)
Team workshop and hand-over
steps: Map the processes and the data you already have
Rank the opportunities by payback and risk
Deliver the roadmap and start the first pilot
en.outcome: A clear, costed plan — and no money spent on AI that does not move the business.

Priorisierte KI-Roadmap mit Kosten, Risiken und Quick Wins
Herstellerneutrale Modell- und Tool-Auswahl (Claude, OpenAI, Open Source)
Team-Workshop und Übergabe

Roadmap übergeben und das erste Pilotprojekt starten
de.outcome: Ein klarer, kalkulierter Plan — und kein Geld für KI, die das Geschäft nicht voranbringt.

fr.tagline: Savoir quoi automatiser avant de dépenser un euro.

includes: Audit des processus et des outils (une demi-journée sur place ou à distance)
Feuille de route IA priorisée avec coûts, risques et gains rapides
Choix neutre des modèles et outils (Claude, OpenAI, open source)
Atelier d'équipe et passation

Classer les opportunités par retour et par risque
Livrer la feuille de route et lancer le premier pilote
fr.outcome: Un plan clair et chiffré — et pas un euro dépensé dans une IA qui ne fait pas avancer l'entreprise.

Roadmap AI prioritizat, cu costuri, riscuri și câștiguri rapide
Alegerea neutră a modelelor și instrumentelor (Claude, OpenAI, open source)
Workshop cu echipa și predare

Livrăm roadmap-ul și pornim primul pilot
ro.outcome: Un plan clar, cu costuri — și niciun ban cheltuit pe AI care nu mișcă afacerea.

اختيار محايد للنماذج والأدوات (Claude وOpenAI والمصادر المفتوحة)
ورشة عمل للفريق وتسليم

تسليم خارطة الطريق وبدء أول مشروع تجريبي
